text: The incremental-selection patch removes limit/offset checks, skips the message-properties task, and skips six date/subject cache-fill and add/remove tasks. The remaining adapter setup waits for invalidation instead of a row-count notification. Grouped and threaded files use their own actual wait helpers, so their similar names are not a missing-method finding. Assertions for displayed fields and child ordering remain source-level checks, with many expected-behavior messages absent in the affected tasks/helpers. These code changes establish coverage limits, not an executed pass or a diagnosis of the author's reported breakage.
title: The incremental Panorama landing narrows active adapter test coverage
